system_info.project_name: IEEE 9-Bus Power Quality Detector and Classifier

mode_a_fast_scenario.name: Fast Scenario Demonstration
mode_a_fast_scenario.description: Executes a finite scheduled 5-second simulation scenario with deterministic injection timing

mode_b_continuous_interactive.name: Continuous Interactive Demonstration
mode_b_continuous_interactive.description: Runs a persistent, unpaused 1:1 real-time Simulink solver streaming live 5 kHz telemetry to the dashboard with on-the-fly injection and recovery

approved_demonstration_presets.label: Normal Baseline Conduction
approved_demonstration_presets.description: Quiescent 60 Hz steady-state grid operation at Bus 5 without electrical disturbances

approved_demonstration_presets.label: Three-Phase Symmetrical Fault Voltage Sag
approved_demonstration_presets.description: Symmetrical shunt fault resulting in measured residual voltage of ~0.41 pu on Bus 5

approved_demonstration_presets.label: Restore Normal Baseline
approved_demonstration_presets.description: De-energizes fault and restores normal sinusoidal grid operating state

approved_demonstration_presets.label: Capacitor Bank Energization Voltage Swell
approved_demonstration_presets.description: Shunt capacitor energization producing overvoltage swell of ~1.25 pu on Bus 5

approved_demonstration_presets.label: Restore Normal Baseline
approved_demonstration_presets.description: Trips shunt capacitor breaker and recovers nominal baseline voltage

approved_demonstration_presets.label: Nonlinear Load Harmonic Injection
approved_demonstration_presets.description: Simulates 3rd, 5th, and 7th harmonic injection producing elevated THD on Bus 5

approved_demonstration_presets.label: Subharmonic Voltage Flicker Modulation
approved_demonstration_presets.description: Low-frequency (8 Hz) envelope modulation producing voltage flicker

approved_demonstration_presets.label: Converter Commutation Notch Injection
approved_demonstration_presets.description: Periodic line commutation notches creating high dV/dt notches per cycle

approved_demonstration_presets.label: High-Frequency Switching Transient
approved_demonstration_presets.description: Oscillatory transient spike typical of transmission switching actions
